id: title:dmarchuk:keep stored secrets when edit is clicked with auto save on

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a new state variable replacingSecret and a computed hiddenSecret, then uses them to control the visibility of a secret-value warning and the behavior of the Edit button. P1.F1.H2 adds a useEffect to reset replacingSecret when the parent secret value changes. P1.F1.H3 replaces the direct secret check with hiddenSecret and wrapping the onChange to strip the secret flag on save.

observations.posthog_connection: This could support a workflow where a Cyclotron configuration input is treated as a secret, and the UI explicitly hides the value and offers an 'Edit' action. The change could help prevent accidental exposure of secret values while still allowing the user to edit them, and could help avoid a UI state where a secret value is displayed or saved incorrectly.
